If you run a registered animal rescue organisation, or know one doing good work, message Sumit Agarwal on WhatsApp at +91 80135 60733. Listing on Save My Stray is free, and the platform doesn't keep any amount donated through it.Message Sumit Agarwal on WhatsApp. Listing is free, 100% of donations go to the rescue org.

Registered rescue organisations post each animal's diagnosis, the vet's estimate and the bills. You microfund any amount from ₹100, and it goes straight to the organisation.
